<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

<meta charset="UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>Happy Teacher's Day - Interactive Portal</title>

<style>

/* ==========================================================================

GLOBAL & PINK/WHITE THEME STYLES

========================================================================== */

:root {

--bg-light: #fff5f8;

--bg-card: #ffffff;

--primary-pink: #ff6b95;

--dark-pink: #d84370;

--soft-pink-border: #f3c2d0;

--text-dark: #33222a;

--text-muted: #886675;

--font-main: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif;

--transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

}



* {

margin: 0;

padding: 0;

box-sizing: border-box;

font-family: var(--font-main);

}



body {

background-color: var(--bg-light);

color: var(--text-dark);

overflow-x: hidden;

line-height: 1.6;

}



.container {

width: 90%;

max-width: 1000px;

margin: 0 auto;

}



/* ==========================================================================

PART 1: HERO SECTION & TASKBARS

========================================================================== */

.hero-section {

min-height: 90vh;

display: flex;

flex-direction: column;

justify-content: center;

align-items: center;

text-align: center;

padding: 4rem 1rem;

background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #ffffff 0%, #ffe4ec 100%);

border-bottom: 1px solid var(--soft-pink-border);

position: relative;

}



.hero-title {

font-size: 3rem;

font-weight: 800;

letter-spacing: -1px;

margin-bottom: 0.5rem;

text-transform: uppercase;

color: var(--primary-pink);

}



.hero-subtitle {

color: var(--text-muted);

font-size: 1.1rem;

margin-bottom: 2.5rem;

max-width: 600px;

}



/* Taskbar Container */

.taskbar-container {

width: 100%;

max-width: 520px;

background: #ffffff;

border: 2px solid var(--soft-pink-border);

padding: 2rem;

border-radius: 16px;

box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(255, 107, 149, 0.15);

display: flex;

flex-direction: column;

gap: 1.25rem;

}



.input-group {

display: flex;

flex-direction: column;

text-align: left;

gap: 0.5rem;

}



.input-group label {

font-size: 0.85rem;

text-transform: uppercase;

letter-spacing: 1px;

color: var(--dark-pink);

font-weight: 700;

}



.taskbar-input {

width: 100%;

padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;

background-color: #fffafc;

border: 1px solid var(--soft-pink-border);

border-radius: 8px;

color: var(--text-dark);

font-size: 1rem;

outline: none;

transition: var(--transition);

}



.taskbar-input:focus {

border-color: var(--primary-pink);

box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 107, 149, 0.25);

}



.btn-enter {

padding: 1rem;

background-color: var(--primary-pink);

color: #ffffff;

border: none;

border-radius: 8px;

font-size: 1.1rem;

font-weight: 700;

text-transform: uppercase;

letter-spacing: 1.5px;

cursor: pointer;

transition: var(--transition);

margin-top: 0.5rem;

}



.btn-enter:hover {

background-color: var(--dark-pink);

transform: translateY(-2px);

box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(216, 67, 112, 0.3);

}



/* ==========================================================================

PART 2: INTERACTIVE TRIBUTE & APPRECIATION DISPLAY

========================================================================== */

.display-section {

padding: 5rem 0;

display: none;

opacity: 0;

transition: opacity 0.8s ease;

}



.display-section.active {

display: block;

opacity: 1;

}



.tribute-card {

background: var(--bg-card);

border: 1px solid var(--soft-pink-border);

border-radius: 16px;

padding: 3rem 2rem;

text-align: center;

position: relative;

box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(255, 107, 149, 0.1);

}



.tribute-header h2 {

font-size: 2.2rem;

margin-bottom: 0.25rem;

color: var(--dark-pink);

}



.tribute-section-tag {

display: inline-block;

background: #ffebf1;

border: 1px solid var(--soft-pink-border);

color: var(--dark-pink);

padding: 0.3rem 1rem;

border-radius: 20px;

font-size: 0.9rem;

font-weight: 600;

margin-bottom: 2rem;

}



.message-box {

font-size: 1.15rem;

color: var(--text-dark);

max-width: 750px;

margin: 0 auto 2rem auto;

line-height: 1.8;

font-style: italic;

border-left: 3px solid var(--primary-pink);

padding-left: 1.5rem;

text-align: left;

}



/* Pre-loaded Teacher Photo Gallery Below Letter */

.gallery-title {

margin-top: 2.5rem;

margin-bottom: 1rem;

font-size: 1.1rem;

text-transform: uppercase;

letter-spacing: 1px;

color: var(--dark-pink);

}



.photo-grid {

display: grid;

grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));

gap: 1rem;

margin-bottom: 3rem;

}



.photo-frame {

aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;

border-radius: 12px;

overflow: hidden;

border: 2px solid var(--soft-pink-border);

background: #fff0f5;

display: flex;

align-items: center;

justify-content: center;

box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(255, 107, 149, 0.1);

transition: var(--transition);

}



.photo-frame:hover {

transform: scale(1.03);

border-color: var(--primary-pink);

}



.photo-frame img {

width: 100%;

height: 100%;

object-fit: cover;

}



/* Expanded Badge Grid */

.badges-grid {

display: grid;

grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));

gap: 1.5rem;

margin-top: 1.5rem;

}



.badge-card {

background: #fff0f5;

border: 1px solid var(--soft-pink-border);

padding: 1.5rem;

border-radius: 12px;

transition: var(--transition);

}



.badge-card:hover {

border-color: var(--primary-pink);

transform: translateY(-4px);

box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(255, 107, 149, 0.15);

}



.badge-icon {

font-size: 2rem;

margin-bottom: 0.5rem;

}



.badge-title {

font-size: 1rem;

font-weight: 700;

color: var(--dark-pink);

margin-bottom: 0.25rem;

}



.badge-desc {

font-size: 0.85rem;

color: var(--text-muted);

}



.action-bar {

margin-top: 3rem;

display: flex;

justify-content: center;

gap: 1rem;

}



.btn-action {

padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;

border: 1px solid var(--soft-pink-border);

background: #ffffff;

color: var(--dark-pink);

border-radius: 8px;

cursor: pointer;

font-weight: 600;

transition: var(--transition);

}



.btn-action:hover {

background: var(--primary-pink);

color: #ffffff;

border-color: var(--primary-pink);

}



/* Floating Animation */

.floating-heart {

position: fixed;

pointer-events: none;

animation: floatUp 3s ease-out forwards;

font-size: 1.5rem;

z-index: 9999;

}



@keyframes floatUp {

0% {

transform: translateY(0) scale(1);

opacity: 1;

}

100% {

transform: translateY(-100vh) scale(1.5);

opacity: 0;

}

}



@media (max-width: 600px) {

.hero-title { font-size: 2rem; }

.tribute-card { padding: 2rem 1rem; }

.message-box { font-size: 1rem; }

.photo-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

}

</style>

</head>

<body>



<!-- ==========================================================================

SECTION 1: HERO & TASKBARS

========================================================================== -->

<section class="hero-section">

<h1 class="hero-title">Teacher's Day Tribute</h1>

<p class="hero-subtitle">Enter your details below to reveal your personalized appreciation portal.</p>



<div class="taskbar-container">

<div class="input-group">

<label for="teacherName">Teacher's Full Name</label>

<input type="text" id="teacherName" class="taskbar-input" placeholder="" required>

</div>



<div class="input-group">

<label for="sectionName">Class / Section Handled</label>

<input type="text" id="sectionName" class="taskbar-input" placeholder="" required>

</div>



<button class="btn-enter" onclick="generateTribute()">ENTER</button>

</div>

</section>



<!-- ==========================================================================

SECTION 2: GENERATED TRIBUTE PORTAL

========================================================================== -->

<section class="display-section" id="tributeSection">

<div class="container">

<div class="tribute-card">

<div class="tribute-header">

<h2 id="displayTeacherName">To Our Dedicated Teacher</h2>

<div class="tribute-section-tag" id="displaySectionName">Section Name</div>

</div>



<div class="message-box" id="displayMessage">

"Minamahal naming Guro sa Filipino
 
Maligayang Buwan ng mga Guro ! Maraming salamat sa pagtitiyaga, pagmamahal, at walang sawang pagtuturo sa amin kahit na kami’y sobrang kukulit. Dahil sa iyo, mas minahal namin ang sarili naming wika at mas naunawaan namin ito. Kaya kayo po ang inspirasyon namin sa aming pag-aaral pagdating sa araling Filipino.
 
Muli, maraming salamat po, Ginang Borja ! Maligayang Buwan ng mga Guro ! mula sa mga minamahal mong 9 Del Pilar [isinulat ni Jhamaika Shane Yambao] [compiled coded and made by Quervey Arnaiz]
"

</div>



<!-- Pre-loaded Teacher Photos Directly Below the Appreciation Letter -->

<h3 class="gallery-title">MALIGAYANG BUWAN NG MGA GURO!</h3>

<div class="photo-grid">

<!-- Replace the src URLs below with your teacher's actual image file paths or web links -->

<div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Teacher Photo 1"></div>

<div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Teacher Photo 2"></div>

<div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Teacher Photo 3"></div>

<div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Teacher Photo 4"></div>

<div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Teacher Photo 5"></div>

</div>



<h3 style="margin-top: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: 1.1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--dark-pink);">

Teacher Recognition Badges

</h3>



<div class="badges-grid">

<div class="badge-card">

<div class="badge-icon">🧠</div>

<div class="badge-title">Knowledge Catalyst</div>

<div class="badge-desc">Transforms complex lessons into pure inspiration.</div>

</div>

<div class="badge-card">

<div class="badge-icon">⭐</div>

<div class="badge-title">Patience Icon</div>

<div class="badge-desc">Always ready to listen, guide, and support through any challenge.</div>

</div>

<div class="badge-card">

<div class="badge-icon">💡</div>

<div class="badge-title">Inspiration Engine</div>

<div class="badge-desc">Encourages every student to dream bigger and reach higher.</div>

</div>

<div class="badge-card">

<div class="badge-icon">💖</div>

<div class="badge-title">Heart of Gold</div>

<div class="badge-desc">Shows unending empathy, care, and understanding to everyone.</div>

</div>

<div class="badge-card">

<div class="badge-icon">🛡️</div>

<div class="badge-title">Class Mentor</div>

<div class="badge-desc">Protects, guides, and builds confidence in every student.</div>

</div>

<div class="badge-card">

<div class="badge-icon">🚀</div>

<div class="badge-title">Future Builder</div>

<div class="badge-desc">Lays the foundational stepping stones for our upcoming success.</div>

</div>

</div>



<div class="action-bar">

<button class="btn-action" onclick="triggerCelebration()">🎉 Send Applause</button>

<button class="btn-action" onclick="resetForm()">✏️ Edit Details</button>

</div>

</div>

</div>

</section>



<!-- ==========================================================================

JAVASCRIPT LOGIC

========================================================================== -->

<script>

function generateTribute() {

const teacherInput = document.getElementById('teacherName').value.trim();

const sectionInput = document.getElementById('sectionName').value.trim();



if (!teacherInput || !sectionInput) {

alert('Please fill in both the Teacher\'s Name and Section fields.');

return;

}



document.getElementById('displayTeacherName').innerText = `Happy Teacher's Day, ${teacherInput}!`;

document.getElementById('displaySectionName').innerText = `Class / Section: ${sectionInput}`;



const tributeSec = document.getElementById('tributeSection');

tributeSec.classList.add('active');

tributeSec.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });



triggerCelebration();

}



function triggerCelebration() {

const icons = ['🌸', '✨', '💖', '👏', '🌷', '⭐'];


for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {

setTimeout(() => {

const el = document.createElement('div');

el.className = 'floating-heart';

el.innerText = icons[Math.floor(Math.random() * icons.length)];

el.style.left = Math.random() * 90 + 5 + 'vw';

el.style.top = '100vh';

document.body.appendChild(el);



setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 3000);

}, i * 100);

}

}



function resetForm() {

window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });

document.getElementById('tributeSection').classList.remove('active');

}

</script>

</body>

</html>
